prompt:
Create ONE finished, polished Japanese manga introduction video thumbnail/end-card, landscape 16:9, target 1920×1080. This is the very last image of the video. Primary requirement: the ACTUAL JAPANESE WORK TITLE must be a HUGE, beautifully designed, immediately readable typographic LOGO, not small caption text.
EXACT TEXT, preserve every character and Japanese corner brackets: 「漫画」 and 「異世界「嘘」ガイド」. Render the literal text without the outer explanatory quotation marks. No other text, no English, no author names. The big title may use two lines: 異世界「嘘」 / ガイド. Make the title logo fill approximately 55–60% of the canvas, on the left and extending through the center; large bold playful Japanese display lettering with thick dark outlines, a bright cream/yellow face for 異世界 and ガイド, vivid pink for 「嘘」, subtle dimensional shadow and a light outline, strong clean contrast even at mobile-thumbnail size. Place 漫画 in a smaller but prominent badge above the title. Keep all title letters within the image with comfortable margins; nothing cropped or hidden.
REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 is the confirmed common fantasy landscape; image 2 is the confirmed heroine Nana, showing her same face, very pale skin, petite slender build, long silver-white hair with outward-flaring locks, red half-lidded eyes, black choker, cream blouse, loose charcoal jacket with gold sleeve buttons, charcoal pleated skirt and black boots; image 3 is the confirmed scene with Nana and the black-haired boy Nagare in a muted blue long-sleeve top, gray trousers and brown shoulder bag; image 4 is the actual character used as the video's presenter, a small purple-haired chibi with the exact hairstyle, white head decorations, violet eyes, pale bluish skin, white kimono-like top with purple/blue band, dark reddish skirt and white footwear. The presenter MUST appear and must closely match reference 4's design and its small pixel-art/chibi proportions, not be replaced with Nana and not redesigned as a different presenter.
COMPOSITION: Combine the confirmed scenes into a single attractive key visual with the same gentle green hills, white stone bridge, red-orange roofs and distant castle as the background. Put one large smiling Nana on the right foreground, one slightly smaller Nagare behind her on the far right. Preserve their identity, hairstyles, colors, outfit details, and natural friendly expressions. Nana has a slightly mischievous guide-like smile and lightly opens a hand toward the title. Include exactly one small but clearly recognizable reference-4 presenter in the lower-left corner beneath the logo, about 25% of the canvas height, fully visible and separated from the letters. The big logo remains the strongest focal point. Integrate scenes through the landscape and figures, without duplicate Nanas, duplicate boys, tiny thumbnail tiles or comic panels. Clean colorful manga rendering for the scene and main pair, crisp faithful sprite-like rendering for the little presenter, warm bright light, balanced uncluttered finishing. No speech balloons, charts, extra people, watermark, or interface elements.
